//: The refactor's acceptance criteria (REFACTOR-PLAN.md: the owner's five acceptance tests A1-A5 and the eight items; RF9-SURVEY.md), made executable by scripts/check/acceptance.mjs (npm run test:acceptance). Each criterion lists its evidence: test files run with node --test, npm scripts, and named assertions the runner implements. A criterion is 'met' or 'open'; an open one lists its gaps, each with a measure and the value it had when recorded. The runner fails when evidence fails, when a measure grows, and when it shrinks without this file being updated (a ratchet: a gap closed is written down, here, and a met criterion never goes back). --browser adds the browser evidence (Playwright).
